description_en: Queries the list of tag keys for Auto Scaling resources
description_zh: 查询弹性伸缩资源标签键的列表
kebab_example: aliyun ess list-tag-keys --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type scalinggroup --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagKeys

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Auto Scaling resource resides
parameters.help_zh: 弹性伸缩资源所属地域的ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Auto Scaling resource type. Set the value to `scalinggroup`, which indicates that the tagged object is a scaling group
parameters.help_zh: 弹性伸缩资源类型。取值：`scalinggroup`，表示标签绑定的对象是伸缩组
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next query. If this parameter is empty, no additional results exist
parameters.help_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token。如果参数值为空表示没有下一个
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。最大值：50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next query. If this parameter is empty, no additional results exist
NextToken.description_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，该参数值为空表示没有下一个

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in the query
PageSize.description_zh: 查询时设置的每页行数
